known: Founded by presidential decree in 2017 (The Spectator Australia).
Chaired by Gayane Umerova, who is also commissioner of the Bukhara Biennial.
The Korea Herald names her and Saida Mirziyoyeva, head of the presidential administration and eldest daughter of the president, as central figures in shaping "Uzbekistan's cultural landscape".

name: Vanuatu Cultural Centre (Vanuatu Kaljoral Senta)
known: Curator Kaitip Kami said 13 display cases were destroyed and objects fell from their cases.
The curator's position is government-funded and there is no extra money for upkeep of the collection (AAP via The Canberra Times, 20 May 2025).

name: Fundación Oswaldo Vigas
known: Non-profit foundation based in Caracas that works to deepen understanding of the Venezuelan painter Oswaldo Vigas and to keep a selection of his work preserved and accessible to institutions, curators, writers and art lovers (Fundación Oswaldo Vigas).

Lorenzo Vigas is chairman, Janine Vigas is custodian and Dilia Hernández is director, with a team that includes an archive and registry coordinator, a documentalist and a conservation and restoration role (Fundación Oswaldo Vigas).
The foundation is chaired by Lorenzo Vigas and its custodian is Janine Vigas (Fundación Oswaldo Vigas).

Axel Stein, former head of Sotheby's Latin American Art Department (2011 to 2018), supported the catalogue raisonné and is the foundation's head of outreach and development (Arte al Día, 22 September 2022;
Its site has a staff page naming a chairman, custodian and director, but no board, reports, accounts or funders.

name: Vincom Center for Contemporary Art
known: Artistic director is Mizuki Endo (Viet Nam News).
Programme in four seasons of about three months, with a Vincom Art Development Fund for conservation and artists' exhibitions.
Viet Nam News (2017) says Vingroup, which it calls Viet Nam's biggest real estate developer, sponsored and financed it, and that Deputy Chairwoman Le Mai Lan spoke at the launch.
Vingroup's founder, largest shareholder and chairman is Pham Nhat Vuong.

name: Nguyen Art Foundation

name: The Factory Contemporary Arts Centre
known: Zoe Butt is named artistic director in Art & Market (2018) and Artribune (2019).
